description:
Retire the `fast_rules` suite's own memory executor in favour of the shared one.

## Background

`memory_executor` in `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/main.rs` seeds an empty configuration and a literal index body carrying `"schema_version": 2`, then delegates to the shared executor, which product initialisation now sets up. Its callers are `fast_rules/{example_rulesets,label_query,label_strategic,validate_rule_runner,validation}_tests.rs`.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/main.rs`: `memory_executor` (`:21`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: `fast_rules/main.rs` defines no executor fixture, and no file in the suite writes a literal schema version or index body.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each former caller uses the shared executor and asserts what it asserted before.
title: fast_rules uses the shared memory executor
